edges.rationale: Understanding latency, throughput, and cost metrics is necessary to evaluate whether hardware acceleration improves inference performance.
Performance metrics provide the baseline for measuring the impact of model size reduction and architectural efficiency on speed and cost.
Service-level refinements must be evaluated against latency, throughput, and cost metrics to determine their effectiveness.
Optimized model architectures and reduced sizes are often required to fully leverage specialized hardware like GPUs and TPUs.
Efficient models reduce the load on serving infrastructure, making service-level optimization more effective.
Serving infrastructure must be designed around the capabilities and constraints of the target hardware accelerators.
